title: What You See Is What You Certify: Concept-Based Certificates for Unseen Compositions
abstract: arXiv:2611.31627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Concept-based models justify a decision by concepts they claim to see, decoded through an explicit ontology. Yet concept predictions are known to leak label information, ignore locality, and be poorly grounded on new attribute combinations. A decision decoded from such concepts can satisfy the ontology and still be wrong, so we ask when it can serve as a certificate. On unseen combinations of familiar parts, a joint concept bottleneck model and a concept embedding model, trained as is standard, certify wrong classes 93-94% of the time despite a correct ontology (60% for a joint model trained only on visible parts and gated by a localizer). The joint model's part errors copy co-occurring values more often than chance (cross-concept shortcutting). Treating the ontology as an error-detecting code, we show that a certificate needs visible evidence excluding every rival, unseen parts reported as such, and rare misreads not driven by a share

translated_title: 所见即所证：面向未见组合的基于概念的证书
translated_abstract: 基于概念的模型通过它们声称“看到”的概念来为决策提供解释，并通过显式的本体论进行解码。然而，众所周知，概念预测会泄露标签信息、忽略局部性，并且在新的属性组合上缺乏可靠基础。由这类概念解码出的决策即使满足本体论仍可能是错误的，因此我们追问：它在什么情况下才能作为一份证书。在熟悉部件的未见组合上，按标准方式训练的联合概念瓶颈模型和概念嵌入模型，即使本体论正确，也有93-94%的时间认证了错误的类别（对于仅在可见部件上训练并由定位器门控的联合模型，这一比例为60%）。联合模型的部件错误比随机水平更频繁地复制共现的属性值（跨概念捷径现象）。通过将本体论视为一种错误检测码，我们证明了有效的证书需要满足：具有排除所有竞争类别的可见证据、将未见部件如实标注为未见、以及误读罕见且不受共享模式驱动的特性。
tldr: 该研究揭示了基于概念的模型在未见属性组合上会以高达93-94%的概率错误认证类别，并将本体论视为错误检测码，据此确立了有效决策证书的三个条件：排除所有竞争类别的可见证据、如实标注未见部件、以及不受共现捷径驱动的罕见误读。
en_tdlr: This work shows that standard concept-based models certify wrong classes 93-94% of the time on unseen compositions, and by treating the ontology as an error-detecting code, it establishes the conditions for a valid certificate: visible evidence excluding every rival, unseen parts reported as such, and rare misreads not driven by co-occurrence shortcutting.
